start.title: Welcome to Hodi
start.intro: Your news, on your own server. Four steps and you’re set: the household, your profile, the AI if you want, then your region.
start.codeHelpWhy: This server can be reached from the Internet: so that nobody sets it up in your place, Hodi asks for the 6-digit code written in its log when it starts. Each restart draws a new one: take the latest.
start.codeHelpLocal: From the server’s computer or your home network, no code is asked.

household.title: Your household
household.intro: Up to 5 profiles share this password, each with its own reading.
household.help: Each device asks for it once, then keeps it for 90 days. 8 characters minimum: the longer it is and the more it mixes capitals, digits and symbols, the stronger it is. You can change the name and the password in Settings › Household.

ai.help: Each purple button is a call paid from your credits, never automatic. Set a monthly spending limit in the provider’s console. You can add, change or remove the key in Settings › AI and credits.

feed.title: Feed
desktop: The last 3 days of articles from your topics, newest first. At the top, the Daily summary and the Headlines: today’s stories, to browse like stories.
“Pick up” keeps the articles you started; the cross removes them. A read article fades; hover a card to hide it. Press ? for keyboard shortcuts.
phone: One row per topic with today’s articles. At the top, the Daily summary and the Headlines, to browse like stories.
Pull down to refresh. Swipe left or right to go from one topic to the next. In a topic, swipe a card right to save it, left to hide it.

followed.title: Followed
desktop: Articles from every topic about the subjects you follow, newest first. An article about two subjects shows under both. Add or remove subjects in Settings › Followed subjects.
phone: Articles from every topic about the subjects you follow, newest first. Swipe a card right to save it, left to hide it. Manage your subjects in Settings › Followed subjects.

shares.title: Shared
desktop: What other profiles of the household sent you with “For…”, for 7 days. A read or hidden article goes away. At the end of an article, react with an emoji: the sender sees it atop their Shared.
phone: What other profiles of the household sent you with “For…”, for 7 days. A read article, or one swiped left, goes away. At the end of an article, react with an emoji: the sender sees it atop their Shared.

videos.title: Videos
desktop: Videos and episodes from the channels you follow, one week at a time, without Shorts. They play here, beside the list. A video watched to the end leaves the list; once started, it waits for you in “Pick up” on the feed. Add channels in Settings › Sources.
phone: Videos and episodes from the channels you follow, one week at a time, without Shorts. A video watched to the end leaves the list; once started, it waits for you in “Pick up” on the home screen. Add channels in Settings › Sources.

resetSettings.title: Reset your settings?

clearStats.title: Clear your stats?

removeKey.title: Remove the AI key?

resetHousehold.title: Refill everyone’s AI?

dialogIntro.daily: The reading time allowed each day. Once it’s used up, the app pauses until tomorrow.
dialogIntro.window: The hours when the app opens. Outside them it stays shut and says when it reopens.
dialogIntro.quiet: During these hours no notification reaches their devices. The app stays open.
dialogIntro.explain: Each time {{name}} asks the AI to explain an article or a word. Counted on the household’s credits.
dialogIntro.week: Their screen time and reading over the last 7 days, never the titles.
dialogIntro.topics: Pick the themes shown in their feed. A theme turned off leaves with its sources, nothing is deleted: turn it back on any time.
dialogIntro.sources: The kids’ catalogue, by theme. Base sources start on: keep the ones that suit them. Only sources that are on reach their feed.
dialogIntro.shareTo: Pick one or more profiles of the household. The article lands in their Shares, with your note if you write one.
dialogIntro.ask: Paste the link of a site or a YouTube channel. Your parents get your request: if they accept, it reaches your feed or Videos.
dialogIntro.request: {{name}} would like this source in their feed. Accepted, it shows up for {{name}} only, filed in the theme below.
dialogIntro.requestChannel: {{name}} would like to follow this channel. Accepted, it shows up for {{name}} only, in their Videos.
